links.outcome: Hallucinations and accuracy of chatbot responses, including guideline references and incident details, in internal testing
links.effect: Assistant was only partially accurate, with hallucinations mainly affecting guideline references and incident details; no quantitative rates reported in abstract.
links.quote: The assistant produced structured, clinically plausible mitigation suggestions but was only partially accurate, with hallucinations mainly affecting guideline references and incident details.

unlisted_practices: Failure-mode database-grounded chatbot to support proactive FMEA-based risk management in radiotherapy
Portal for staff submission of failure modes to expand a harmonised failure mode database

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility, accuracy/hallucination rate, and clinician usability of a prototype generative AI assistant (i-SART) for proactive risk management in radiotherapy.
